title: Cleopatra daughter of Philip
summary: Raleigh names Cleopatra daughter of Philip in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cleopatra, Daughter of Philip and Olympias, married to her Vncle Alexander King of Epirus, and after her Brother Alexanders death slaine at Sardis by Antigonus. She is not Cleopatra VII. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
